# Foundry

> Neo Bauhaus visual identity. Part of The Collective Style Guide Library.

Geometric sans, primary palette (red/yellow/blue), sharp corners (0 radius),
grid-forward composition. Direct, declarative voice. Built on IBM Carbon's
accessible component foundation.

## Use this variant for

Engineering tools, ops platforms, financial dashboards, serious B2B SaaS.

## Modes & densities

- Modes: `light`, `dark`
- Densities: `comfortable`, `compact`
- RTL: supported (locales tested: en, de, fr, es, ja, ar)

## Quick token reference (light mode)

- Background: #FAFAFA  / Surface: #FFFFFF  / Text: #0A0A0A
- Accent: #ED1C24 (red) / #FCD300 (yellow) / #1A4FAD (blue)
- Radius: 0  /  Sans: futura-pt  /  Display: futura-pt-bold

## Install

```ts
import { theme } from "@collective/foundry";
import { ThemeProvider } from "@collective/foundation";

<ThemeProvider theme={theme} mode="light" density="comfortable">
  <YourApp />
</ThemeProvider>
```
